records.voiceSummary: Infosys Limited issued a press release on November 12, 2026, announcing that the Infosys Science Foundation awarded the Infosys Prize 2026 to six researchers. The laureates are Karthik Sastry in Economics, Swarun Kumar in Engineering and Computer Science, Gautam Bhatia in Humanities and Social Sciences, Isha Jain in Life Sciences, Riddhipratim Basu in Mathematical Sciences, and Manoj Kumar Joshi in Physical Sciences. Each winner receives a gold medal, a citation, and a prize purse of USD 100,000. The prize honors researchers under the age of 40. The winners were selected by an international panel of jurors and announced by the trustees of the Infosys Science Foundation. The information is hosted on the company website at www.infosys.com.

records.voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced a collaboration with PTC to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management. The partnership involves launching a pre-configured semiconductor Product Lifecycle Management solution built on the PTC Windchill platform. This solution aims to streamline product development, strengthen quality and compliance, and reduce operational complexity. It connects people, processes, and data across the semiconductor lifecycle, including IP management, new product introduction, supplier collaboration, and regulatory compliance. The solution integrates with existing business, manufacturing, and design systems for end-to-end visibility. HCLTech and PTC stated that the collaboration helps customers modernize product development and management at scale. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.

records.voiceSummary: Mahindra and Mahindra submitted its production, sales, and export figures for October 2026 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The report details monthly performance data for various vehicle categories including utility vehicles, vans, e-rickshaws, e-carts, and three-wheelers. Sales figures for utility vehicles show a total of 123,752 units in October 2026 compared to 94,873 units in October 2025. Commercial vehicle sales totaled 126,706 units in October 2026 versus 118,097 units in the previous year. Export sales reached 7,241 units in October 2026, up from 4,079 units in October 2025. Consolidated revenue rose 25% to Rs. 57,553 crores, with profit after tax increasing 25% to Rs. 4,588 crores. Return on equity stood at 21%. Auto business profit grew 55%, while Farm sector profit declined 9%. Mahindra Finance profit increased 61%, and Tech M profit rose 33%. Logistics showed a significant turnaround, and Accelo profit grew 70%. The company maintained its long-term targets of 15% to 20% EPS growth and 18% RoE. records.voiceSummary: Titan Company Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE on 11th November 2026 regarding the transcript of the Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The transcript discusses unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Management reported consolidated growth driven by innovation. Titan Jewellery recorded a customs duty gain of Rs. 490 crores, while CaratLane recorded Rs. 46 crores. Normalized margins were stated as 11.1% for Titan Jewellery and 11.7% after adjusting for mark-to-market reversals. A fair value adjustment of Rs. 671 crores was recognized on the Damas acquisition liability. Management noted festive season trends showed strong starts and endings with softness in between due to gold price volatility.
